import pygame
import random

# Initialize Pygame
pygame.init()

# Define some colors
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
RED = (255, 0, 0)
GREEN = (0, 255, 0)

# Set the width and height of the screen (width, height).
size = (700, 500)
screen = pygame.display.set_mode(size)

pygame.display.set_caption("Action Game")

# Loop until the user clicks the close button.
done = False
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

class Player(pygame.Rect):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(0, 0, 50, 50)
        self.speed = 5
        self.health = 100

    def move(self, dx, dy):
        self.x += dx
        self.y += dy

    def is_alive(self):
        return self.health > 0

class Bullet(pygame.Rect):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__(x, y, 10, 10)
        self.speed = 10

    def move(self):
        self.x += self.speed

class Game:
    def __init__(self):
        self.players = [Player(), Player()]
        self.bullets = []

    def handle_events(self):
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                return False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key == pygame.K_SPACE:
                    self.players[0].shoot()

    def update(self):
        for bullet in self.bullets:
            bullet.move()
            if bullet.x > size[0]:
                self.bullets.remove(bullet)

        for player in self.players:
            player.move(0, 5)

        for bullet in self.bullets:
            for player in self.players:
                if bullet.colliderect(player):
                    player.health -= 10
                    self.bullets.remove(bullet)

    def draw(self):
        screen.fill(WHITE)
        for player in self.players:
            pygame.draw.rect(screen, RED, player)
        for bullet in self.bullets:
            pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, bullet)

        font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)
        text = font.render(f"Player 1 Health: {self.players[0].health}", True, (10, 10, 10))
        screen.blit(text, (10, 10))
        text = font.render(f"Player 2 Health: {self.players[1].health}", True, (10, 10, 10))
        screen.blit(text, (10, 40))

        pygame.display.flip()

    def run(self):
        while not done:
            done = self.handle_events()
            self.update()
            self.draw()
            clock.tick(60)

        pygame.quit()

game = Game()
game.run()
